priority: broaden free external comparison traffic with four existing mechanics while preserving zero cash spend and avoiding new concept production before traffic signals justify it

games.title: Color Stack Sort
games.short_description: Move colored dots between tubes and sort every stack before the clock runs out.
games.description: Color Stack Sort is a timed sorting puzzle built around short repeatable runs. Move top dots between tubes, complete monochrome stacks, clear successive boards for bonus time, and compare board depth, move efficiency, replay and sharing.

games.title: Maze Dash
games.short_description: Tap through quick mazes, reach the goal and clear as many boards as possible before time expires.
games.description: Maze Dash is a rapid tap-maze challenge. Navigate from start to goal, earn bonus time for each clear and progress into larger mazes during the same run. It adds a pathfinding mechanic to the external comparison set with clean depth, replay and share signals.

games.title: One Back
games.short_description: Remember the previous symbol and decide whether each new symbol is the same or different in 30 seconds.
games.description: One Back is a 30-second working-memory game built for rapid retries. Keep the previous symbol in memory, classify the next card as same or different, protect time from wrong answers and chase a higher score across repeated runs.

games.title: Word Scramble Rush
games.short_description: Unscramble as many words as possible in 45 seconds and challenge a friend to beat the score.
games.description: Word Scramble Rush is a 45-second word game with simple tap controls. Rebuild scrambled words, lose time for wrong submissions and push for a higher word count before the clock runs out. It adds a language mechanic to the portfolio's free traffic tests.
